scope: Official election results for Calgary Centre and Calgary Confederation (2019,2021,2025 federal) and Calgary-Buffalo and Calgary-Mountain View (2019,2023 provincial).
geographyWarning: Entire riding totals, not neighbourhood voting. Earlier federal entries are historical same-named ridings, not an address-level reconstruction of which district each present-day property belonged to.
affiliationWarning: Candidate party labels reflect election time. Historical winners are not automatically the current representative.
boundaryRule: Group charts by boundarySeriesId. A boundary break is required between federal 2021 and 2025 results; do not compute a like-for-like geographic swing across it. Federal 2019 and 2021 share the 2013 Representation Order. Provincial 2019 and 2023 share the 2017 divisions.
roundingRule: Official one-decimal candidate shares and turnout retained; vote counts sum to official valid ballots. Margins are calculated from vote counts.
historicalJoin: currentRepresentativeId links a current district card to its same-name riding history only; the winner field carries the actual historical elected candidate.
